origin.description: Send the text captured so far to the text handler before the expression continues.
origin.details: Without a flush, consecutive cat() calls are one piece of text. A flush splits them.
origin.example:
test <- function() {
  cat("hi")
  flush_console()
  cat("bye")
}
ev <- evaluate("test()")
cat(ev[[2]], ev[[3]], sep = "/")
